assets.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Edit ONE transparent pixel-art environmental sprite. Image1 is edit target, image2 is STYLE REFERENCE only (older approved game facility). The current sprite is too intricate for this roguelike. REDRAW with the same overall object identity, orientation, palette family and low front-view perspective, but radically SIMPLER internals matching the large flat pixel clusters of furniture in image2. A low wide gray and muted teal metal arch. Keep its EMPTY transparent center passage reaching bottom; absolutely no door leaves, floor, steps or building. Five member emblems reduced to bold small patches: red skull, orange feather, purple curl, tan lens, blue fin. Remove ornate gold medallion rings, bevel layers, screws, scuff texture. Logical48x24, final96x48. Maximum12-14 flat colors TOTAL, only two or three shades per material, large contiguous color areas, dark outline. Actual coarse pixel art designed at the stated logical grid, enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. No gradients, antialiasing, painterly brushwork, glowing cloud, fine texture, speckled highlights or stray single-pixel greebles. Full object centered on true transparent background, transparent outer margin; NO ground, cast shadow, character, writing, watermark, extra props or whole scene. Keep readable at native game scale. Simplicity over decorative detail.
